en: Black‑and‑white, multi‑view interior postcard showing four photographs of a modernist mid‑20th‑century restaurant or hotel café. The upper-left view depicts a dining area with small square tables, minimalist chairs, table lamps, and a large landscape painting on a dark wood-paneled wall. The upper-right view shows a long bar counter with high stools, glass shelves with bottles and glasses behind it, and spot lighting above. The lower-left view presents another seating section with small tables, upholstered chairs, decorative standing lamps and an elaborate ceiling light installation made of many small bulbs. The lower-right view features a larger dining space with several grouped tables, wood-paneled walls, patterned wallpaper, framed pictures, and a coffered ceiling. No visible handwritten or printed text appears on the image side.
